newsitem.title: UK: Commerzbank sets warrants on international indices.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank sets warrants on international indices.

text.p: Commezbank AG has issued 270 million American-style call and put warrants, in 27 equal tranches, on various international indices, lead manager Commerz Financial Products said.

There are eight tranches on the S&P 500 index (four tranches of calls and four tranches of puts), eight tranches on the CAC 40 index (four calls and four puts) and 11 tranches on the Nikkei 225 index (seven tranches of calls and four tranches of puts). There are various maturity dates.
The warrants will be listed on Frankfurt and Duesseldorf exchanges and the pay date is February 19, 1997.
